title: Bridge head schema references during contract relocation
goal: Allow the base policy-candidate engine to validate a changed document against its relocated schema from the explicit head commit.
acceptanceCriteria: The base registry continues to define policy obligations and authorization coverage.
A changed head document uses the schema path from the schema-valid head registry when that registered schema relocates.
The schema bytes are read from the explicit head Git object when the schema path changed.
A bidirectional legacy/shared schema relocation fixture passes candidate validation.
Existing trusted-base negative controls and parity remain unchanged.
Trusted Diff and TCB candidate validation pass with exact authorization consumption.
